title: Event
description: One published event row. Every value is a string and every key is always present; an unknown field is "", never null and never missing.

artist_ids.description: Comma-separated Artist ids, in the order the title named them.

room.description: The room the venue label named ("Oude Zaal" for "Melkweg (Oude Zaal)"); "" when it named only the building.

lat.description: The venue's latitude in decimal degrees, as the source's schema.org location stated it; "" when it did not.

address.description: The venue's street address as the source stated it; "" when it did not.
